purpose: Per-case evidence class for the 30 proposed expected labels (CodeRabbit finding r4428742321). Classification is implementer-proposed and does not change any expected label; the human/domain referee records ACCEPT/REJECT/REVISE in the oracle packet. Line references are to the unchanged sources at Git blobs 8290c51c (tools/gner_verify_e1.py), 8517a93f (tests/test_gner_verify_e1.py) and docs/GNER_E1.md at 52aa7c0e.

classes.CONTRACT_EXPLICIT: The specific condition and its state are stated in docs/GNER_E1.md or pinned by an unchanged conventional test in tests/test_gner_verify_e1.py, and implemented in tools/gner_verify_e1.py.
classes.IMPLEMENTATION_DERIVED: The expected state was read from the unchanged tools/gner_verify_e1.py source. Documentation does not name the condition; no unchanged test pins it. Agreement with the implementation is therefore expected by construction and is a regression pin, not an independent requirement.
classes.PROPOSED_POLICY: The expected state is STRICTER than the unchanged source (bool-vs-int). Neither documentation nor any existing test requires it. A disagreement here is a proposal-to-code mismatch, not a confirmed defect, until a referee accepts the label with a contract citation.

valid_failure.rationale: Run metadata agrees on every compared field; documented CANONICAL_VERIFIED meaning; pinned by test_matching_canonical_metadata.

wrong_run.rationale: Run id contradiction; pinned by test_other_run_conflicts.

wrong_sha.rationale: SHA prefix contradiction; pinned by test_false_sha_conflicts.

wrong_workflow.rationale: Lead workflow 'fake-gate' is outside ALLOWED_WORKFLOWS and differs from canonical name. The allowlist is implementation; documentation only says contradictions are CONFLICT.

unknown_pr.rationale: PR hint absent from empty pull_requests; documented deliberate abstention; pinned by test_pr_association_abstains.

valid_success.rationale: Agreement with success conclusion and a NOTIFICATION_LEAD; no failure-claim branch applies.

valid_review.rationale: PR association confirmed, all other fields agree.

invalid_lead_state.rationale: Default state is CONFLICT with reason 'invalid lead'. Documentation does not define the state for a malformed lead; the in-source smoke test pins CONFLICT.

invalid_missing_run.rationale: run_id None fails isinstance int; ABSTAIN 'run identifier absent'. Documentation does not name this condition.

invalid_negative_run.rationale: run_id <= 0 branch in reconcile; the existing test pins the verify_lead side only.

invalid_canonical_sha.rationale: head_sha fails the 40-hex pattern; CONFLICT 'invalid canonical head SHA'.

invalid_canonical_repo.rationale: repository {} has no full_name; treated as repository mismatch.

unsupported_event.rationale: Event allowlist (pull_request, push, workflow_dispatch) is implementation only. Live probe shows real repository-admission-gate runs use pull_request_review / pull_request_target and are therefore always CONFLICT through the supported entry point.

missing_workflow.rationale: Canonical name None differs from lead workflow.

missing_prs.rationale: Documentation: 'the PR association array may be absent, resulting in deliberate abstention'.

other_pr.rationale: Same branch as the pinned PR-association test with a different PR number present.

skip_terminal.rationale: 'skipped' is in the implementation's terminal list; documentation defines no terminal-conclusion list.

neutral_terminal.rationale: 'neutral' is in the implementation's terminal list; documentation defines no terminal-conclusion list.

invalid_status.rationale: status 'queued' is the same not-terminal branch as the pinned in_progress case.

unsupported_conclusion.rationale: Implementation-boundary check (CodeRabbit r4428742321): 'action_required' is excluded from the implementation's terminal list, so ABSTAIN matches the code; docs/GNER_E0.md and docs/GNER_E1.md define no terminal list and never mention action_required. Live probe run 41132641562 shows action_required does occur in authenticated GitHub data.

unknown_run_id_as_str.rationale: A string run_id fails isinstance int in reconcile. verify_lead (106) also rejects it before any network call.

type_canonical_bool_id.rationale: Source compares canonical id with != ; True == 1 so a boolean canonical id passes. Expected CONFLICT is a proposed strict-type requirement. Not reachable from GitHub JSON observed in the live probe (id is an integer in every response).

type_lead_bool_id.contract_ref: tools/gner_verify_e1.py:106 (verify_lead uses `type(run_id) is not int`, which rejects bool at the live boundary)
type_lead_bool_id.rationale: reconcile uses isinstance(run_id, int), which accepts bool. Expected ABSTAIN is a proposed strict-type requirement. verify_lead already enforces the strict form, so the case is unreachable through the supported entry point (live probe bool_lead_run_id_reachability).

type_boolean_pr_in_canonical.rationale: pull_requests[].number True equals lead pr 1 under ==. Expected ABSTAIN is a proposed strict-type requirement. Not observed in GitHub JSON (number is an integer in every live response). Note for referee: under the 'malformed canonical => CONFLICT' principle used by type_canonical_bool_id this label would be CONFLICT; the proposed label follows the 'PR association not confirmed => ABSTAIN' branch instead. Label unchanged; flagged as a consistency question.

type_lead_bool_pr.rationale: Lead pr True matches canonical number 1 under ==. Expected ABSTAIN is a proposed strict-type requirement. Reachable through verify_lead only if a caller passes pr=True AND the real run is associated with PR #1 (live probe bool_lead_pr_reachability returned ABSTAIN against PR list [1077]); unreachable through the CLI because parse_notification emits int or None.
